publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Review-only scientific algorithmic anatomical or pathology reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, histology slide, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: NLM MeSH supplied controlled condition identity and scope; official NIH/WHO sources supplied conservative anatomical, pathology, and communication boundaries only. No source image or design was copied.

reviewStandard: Current controlled condition identity, disease-versus-symptom boundary, umbrella-versus-specific disease scope, anatomically conservative representation, non-diagnostic status, non-stigmatizing communication, crop-safe geometry, and exact prompt must be frozen before exactly one generation call per route. Observed output controls later metadata.

assets.representationBoundary: Non-diagnostic anatomical orientation to brain, autonomic pathways, and gastrointestinal tract; not a depiction of a patient, symptom severity, or a visible lesion.
Non-diagnostic neurodevelopmental anatomical orientation to brain, synapse, and gut-brain axis; never a damaged-brain claim or portrait of an autistic person.
Anatomically conservative distal-esophagus cutaway showing a localized salmon-toned metaplastic mucosal segment above the gastroesophageal junction; representative, not graded or diagnostic.
Neutral brain and gut-brain anatomical orientation; no split brain, theatrical mood contrast, distressed person, or claim of visible diagnostic pathology.
Clinical sagittal breast-anatomy cutaway with one restrained localized ductal lesion; representative anatomy and tumor location only, not staging, subtype, sex restriction, or diagnosis.
Umbrella-system orientation with anatomically correct heart and major vessels plus one restrained arterial-wall inset; not a claim that atherosclerosis represents all cardiovascular diseases.
